interpretation.OBSERVED: Actual density amplitude decreases ~10x; primary changes <.04%; epsilon_v decreases; all3 primary values move toward unaccepted B.
interpretation.INFERENCE: Small response along this fixed-Ra joint beta/g path is consistent with finite-density formulation effects contributing to part of the A/B gap on this grid.
interpretation.HYPOTHESIS: rho-weighted continuity/transport and related Route A terms may contribute to the gap; support is PARTIAL/hypothesis-generating, not causal proof.
interpretation.UNKNOWN: Causal fraction/dominance, continuum response, asymptotic beta rate, model/grid interaction and residual-normalization effects. H is not a partial derivative with respect to beta at fixed g.

320_reassessment.reason: H PASS supports a bounded fixed-grid characterization; response smaller than current grid indicators reinforces the need for refinement before continuum claims, not proof of negligible H effect. No evidence demands immediate320 as the only next step. Targeted Ra1e6 alone cannot resolve all A/B formal prerequisites; review prerequisite tension first.
320_reassessment.conditional_future_trigger: If grid-independent model/force/coupling accuracy claims are central, preregister targeted refinement; no guaranteed Gate F PASS.

thesis_allowed_claims.EN: At Ra=10^6 and Pr=0.71 on the common 160 × 160 grid, the prescribed beta/10 and g×10 perturbation reduced betaDeltaT from 10^-3 to 10^-4 and changed Nu_cavity, Umax and Wmax by 0.039204%, 0.023917% and 0.011050%, respectively.
thesis_allowed_claims.JA: Ra=1e6、Pr=0.71の共通160²格子で、beta/10・g×10の規定摂動によりbetaDeltaTを1e-3から1e-4へ低下させたところ、Nu_cavity・Umax・Wmaxはそれぞれ0.039204%・0.023917%・0.011050%変化した。

thesis_allowed_claims.EN: The maximum relative density deviation decreased from 4.9694763 × 10^-4 to 4.9694951 × 10^-5, approximately one order of magnitude.
thesis_allowed_claims.JA: 最大相対密度偏差は4.9694763e-4から4.9694951e-5へ、約一桁低下した。

thesis_allowed_claims.EN: All three preregistered Gate H primary sensitivity criteria and the reconstructed-volume-divergence non-worsening condition were satisfied for the accepted pair.
thesis_allowed_claims.JA: acceptedな二条件について、既定Gate Hの主要3量の感度条件と再構成volume divergenceの非悪化条件をすべて満たした。

thesis_allowed_claims.EN: All three perturbed Route A principal QoIs moved closer to the corresponding computed Route B values; Route B at Ra=10^6 was unaccepted, so this comparison is diagnostic and does not establish a causal mechanism.
thesis_allowed_claims.JA: 摂動後のRoute A主要3量は、対応するRoute B computed値にいずれも近づいた。ただしRa=1e6のRoute Bはunacceptedであり、この比較は診断的で因果機構を確立しない。
